TUTORIAL: In the year 3050, Earth is nearly depleted of its natural resources, causing the economy to be in shambles. With extreme financial debt passed down from past generations, you are in a desperate situation. Luckily, the Agricultural Space Society, led by the trillionaire boss known as “The Man” and funded by his oligarchy status, is enlisting space pioneers.

Of course, you have no choice but to enlist, and are given a one-way flight to the newly human-colonized planet “Terra 5”, a meager pack of gardening tools, and a small amount of funds. Your new life on Terra 5 and other planets will involve aiding the inter-planetary human colonization effort by nurturing a small farm property of your very own, with a percentage of your profits and scientific findings going to the Agricultural Space Society, of course. Good luck, space pioneer!
